name: WayriCAD Portable Assets
description: Make KiCad projects self-contained using reviewed footprint, symbol, and 3D-model snapshots.
description_full: WayriCAD Portable Assets snapshots placed PCB footprints into a project-local library, relinks schematic symbols, embeds resolvable 3D models, creates an optional native Embedded Files recovery vault, and repairs missing footprint links from PCB geometry. A native PCB Editor ActionPlugin launches the workbench in an isolated GUI process and passes the active board path directly. A fresh unchanged analysis is required before each write. Network model retrieval is disabled by default. Lock-file checks, explicit confirmation, S-expression validation, conventional KiCad backup archives plus transactional backups, atomic replacement, and unresolved-model reporting protect project files.
